title: Pin linked launcher artifacts from registration through terminal publication
outcome: A linked run retains the original registration-time physical artifact identity and admits only its captured terminal result into live history.
acceptance: A deterministic registration-to-first-END control proves the original directory associates and yields the original durable result, while substituting a different directory with the same request identity cannot claim the registration.

After terminal capture, changing results in the same linked directory cannot publish replacement facts through indexed list or SSE. Restoring the original data restores availability, with durable producer proof unchanged.
